conclusion: No material loss of a still-binding ADR0003 clause identified in the proposed successor, after applying already accepted ADR0004/0014/0026/0028 scoped refinements. This is preservation review, not owner acceptance of the whole replacement or permission to retire ADR0003.

clauses.clause: Post-corruption override
clauses.disposition: Preserved with existing ADR0026: ordinary stop, read-only source, fresh verified baseline, admissible merge; no quarantine/count resurrection.

clauses.clause: Accepted target/baseline and scoped metadata-only verifier ownership
clauses.disposition: Preserve historical decision date/baseline as provenance; successor is proposed until whole replacement approval. ADR0004/0008 remain active; no new acceptance date is invented.

clauses.clause: Domain-based partition, local Git subject, historical truth distinct from default runtime
clauses.disposition: Partition by described domain; immutable Provider observations remain Context. Current Catalog3 Schema21 is still the default.

clauses.clause: Core authority and INSERT-only
clauses.disposition: No application UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE, destructive correction, mutable progress/revision or GC.

clauses.clause: Durable mutable-authoritative Context, exact text/evidence
clauses.disposition: Not disposable; preserve latest-state/conflicts and separately governed text GC.

clauses.clause: Operational execution responsibility and retained PF guarantees
clauses.disposition: Reconstructible work/attempts/cache; no authoritative truth or zero-cost resumed request after loss.

clauses.clause: Derivative Search, explicit rebuild
clauses.disposition: Correct-authority scan fallback with diagnostics; explicit Search create/rebuild; Access is not domain Search authority.

clauses.clause: Four physical/logical stores; Git-only Context independence
clauses.disposition: The explicit four-store count is the substantive change to five responsibility classes. Offline Git-only use still does not require initializing Context or Access. No automatic runtime switch.

clauses.clause: Core rule1 metadata-only and precise checked-byte admission
clauses.disposition: Qualified metadata without bytes/rehash/Context; checked bytes still require identity/type/size and atomic intrinsic structure; unknown child is not verified closure.

clauses.clause: Core rule2 actual observations, original time/provenance and ref change retention
clauses.disposition: No URL/configuration rewrite of facts, no fabricated old observations, prior captures and ref history remain.

clauses.clause: Core rule3 unreachable retention and no admitted-content GC
clauses.disposition: Nonacquisition is distinct from deleting admitted evidence/bytes; apply ADR0014 retained-body scope.

clauses.clause: Core rule4 technical rows, exact replay, no replacement loopholes
clauses.disposition: Explicit application-visible INSERT-only includes technical rows; full replay comparison; no REPLACE/upsert/drop-recreate loopholes.

clauses.clause: Core rule5 remodel prior mutable columns/revision
clauses.disposition: No mutable verified/completion/progress/revision pointer in Core; implementation inventory remains engineering work.

clauses.clause: Core rule6 decoder provenance, no generic winner, integrity/no in-place repair
clauses.disposition: Preserve precise decoder/local checks and atomic structure; ADR0026 replaces obsolete quarantine/count/in-place post-fault mechanisms.

clauses.clause: Core rule7 permanent repository UUID and minimal provenance
clauses.disposition: Minimal actual Core evidence stays understandable without Provider/Source/Access foreign rows; names/endpoints are not entity identity.

clauses.clause: Context rule1 current-state/field-clock/Source/children/head-base semantics
clauses.disposition: Q01-Q04, missing/null, alternatives, real clocks, required children, actual role/head/base and no hidden full edit-history archive remain.

clauses.clause: Context rule2 association ownership and dependency direction
clauses.disposition: PR-Git association is Context; underlying Git capture is independently valid in Core; portable typed references only; no reverse required row.

clauses.clause: Context rule3 split mixed tables by meaning
clauses.disposition: Classify fields, not whole-table rename/move; a PR trigger does not move a Git fact to Context.

clauses.clause: Context rule4 Provider text, exact UTF8/SHA256 and lifetime
clauses.disposition: Exact text and digest collision checks belong in Context; future Context GC policy stays distinct.

clauses.clause: Context rule5 no Publication/general history/winner
clauses.disposition: No universal bundle/seal/eligibility owner, API full edit log, parser winner or domain publication gate.

clauses.clause: Git-only init/local input/query/export/backup independence
clauses.disposition: Offline Core operations do not require Context/Access/credentials/network; metadata-only remains valid; retained-byte output remains separate.

clauses.clause: Cross-file references and typed dependency validation
clauses.disposition: No assumed SQLite cross-file FK. Application validation and conservative absent/stale/conflicting dependencies remain required.

clauses.clause: Cross-store write truth and idempotent failure recovery
clauses.disposition: Core first remains valid if later Context fails; no fabricated closure, no extension of disposable PF-P07 relaxation to two authorities.

clauses.clause: Pinned Core or coherent paired read snapshots
clauses.disposition: No mixing versions and claiming coverage; freeze Access settings before external work, not new cross-authority validity owner.

clauses.clause: Retention/cascade and known-positive boundaries
clauses.disposition: Context/Provider/Source/Access changes never cascade to admitted Git facts; no fake absence from inventory loss.

clauses.clause: Git-only versus paired full backup; formats/hashes/pairing/no overwrite
clauses.disposition: Preserved under current ADR0026; old CAS41 counter is historical, actual checks and atomic no-overwrite remain. No whole-repository restorability claim.

clauses.clause: Search correct-source fallback and no implicit hydration
clauses.disposition: Explicit correct-authority scan fallback with diagnostics and rebuild/creation. Metadata-only does not require raw-body fetch.

clauses.clause: Operational loss cannot invalidate authoritative data
clauses.disposition: Disposable execution/cache state is not Context and cannot erase domain authority or silently replenish old budget.

clauses.clause: PF-P06 placement replacement
clauses.disposition: Five responsibility classes; preserve durable truth versus disposable execution/search separation.

clauses.clause: PF-P08 full catalog backup
clauses.disposition: Core+Context paired domain backup and truthful Git-only scope stay valid without Access; Access backup is separate.

clauses.clause: PF-P05 no current GC; future Context GC01/02; GC03/04 open
clauses.disposition: No current domain-text GC; future conservative Context-only GC; no extension to Core.

clauses.clause: PF-P14/15 correct-authority Search
clauses.disposition: Core/Context-specific direct fallback and truthful completeness.

clauses.clause: PF-P07 relaxed disposable atomicity not authoritative pairing
clauses.disposition: No excuse for inconsistent Core/Context writes, snapshots or backups.

clauses.clause: Not reopened UUID/Q01-Q04/Coverage/trust/time/PF/ADR0001
clauses.disposition: Apply current0014/0026/0028 scopes; preserve classified microseconds, original Capture pair, finite cumulative work, five-column Coverage and Source positive evidence.

clauses.clause: Non-goals, no table-count guess, constrained engineering work
clauses.disposition: Prose alone is not implementation, migration, GC, merge or runtime activation. Names/DDL/fences are engineering work within settled decisions.

clauses.clause: Deferred DS-R01/R03-R08 and source-unclear CAS IDs
clauses.disposition: Deferred scope is preserved. Use explicit original list in retirement writeup; DS-R02 future Context textGC has its own PF-P05 constraints and is not a new architecture question.

clauses.clause: Acceptance1 independent Git-only + zero-body roundtrip
clauses.disposition: Local actual capture/query plus backup/restore and metadata-only support remain acceptance requirements, not prose PASS.

clauses.clause: Acceptance2 append-only attacks and ref rewrite retention
clauses.disposition: No UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE including recovery/hydration/administration; prior actual refs/objects remain.

clauses.clause: Acceptance3 Provider/current-state outside Core and no false full restore
clauses.disposition: Context current-value behavior/conflicts remain; missing Context cannot become full restoration success.

clauses.clause: Acceptance4 PR-triggered independent Core and honest partial writes
clauses.disposition: No false closure/coverage after partial writes; unverified metadata is not inherently failed bytes.

clauses.clause: Acceptance5 retained bytes/digest/identity/scope/fallback
clauses.disposition: Actual domain/retained-byte validation and classified trust apply, not old quarantine counters or archive promise.

clauses.clause: Acceptance6 exact effective tree, independent review, dev/release distinction
clauses.disposition: Review and execution require exact source; owner approval, merge and release qualification remain distinct.

clauses.clause: Boundary freeze is not evidence that implementation passed
clauses.disposition: No self-certification by documentation.
